summary: Freeport-McMoRan reported third quarter 2026 copper production of about 830 million pounds and gold output of roughly 230 thousand ounces, broadly in line with internal expectations despite a shift in gold sales timing. The deferral of around 60 thousand ounces of refined gold sales into the fourth quarter and guidance for lower Q3 gold sales highlight how shipment schedules and Indonesian smelter logistics can influence reported results, even when underlying mine performance tracks...
